errors.text_span: се подобрява леко до около 710 хиляди квадратни метра през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the value improves (increases) to about 710 in 2017. In the figure, the value decreases from 2016 (approx. 740) to 2017, where it is approximately 700.
The description omits the data point for the year 2020, which is approximately 1025. It jumps directly from describing 2019 to 2021.
The word "подобрява" (improves) is a subjective interpretation of the data's movement. A neutral description would use terms like "увеличава" (increases).
